name: portgarden
description: A Windows utility for seeing what is holding your ports, which project owns it, what it is serving, and ending it safely.
author: portgarden contributors

scripts.bench: pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/bench-probe.ps1 && pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/bench-fasttier.ps1 && pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/bench-host.ps1 && pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/bench-netstat.ps1
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
